promised_sections.section: Research notes: what I couldn't reach

price_why: A fly-tying creator would get a couple of specific, easy-to-shoot posts out of this, especially the dry-versus-wet-in-a-glass carousel and the hackle-turn strip. The research log, blocked-site list and internal jargon make it read like a working memo, so I don't think they'd pay more than a small amount.
one_line: A research-backed brief that leads with one concrete, well-specified dry-versus-wet carousel and adds a few borrowed-format ideas for beginner fly-tying posts, padded with thin trend and process sections.
strongest: The lead post is a fully specified 4-slide carousel with a settled cover, a same-angle same-scale wet/dry comparison, a clear beginner payoff and explicit failure conditions. It also says the effect is untested until the creator shoots it.
weakest: Much of the answer is process leakage and filler ('medium does not carry', 'the method asks for 30–50' pages, blocked-site lists, a thin trends section, an empty reach section). The nymph side of the creator's work is ignored, and several cross-niche ideas have no settled hook.
